source_only_permission: Read only original Event cores and their locationID/island/decimalLatitude/decimalLongitude/year/eventDate/samplingProtocol/samplingEffort, no Occurrence extension bytes, no tree species or beetle species/abundance.

site_join.key: Uppercase letters A-Z and digits 0-9 retained from author Event locationID, e.g. TER-NFBF-T-01 and TER_NFBF_T01 become TERNFBFT01
site_join.coordinates_secondary_validation: Difference at most 0.0003 decimal degrees in both lat and longitude between original paired plot coordinates; 2012/2013 author roundoff allowed
site_join.date_alignment: Qualifying years of both sources must occur in 2012/2013 on Terceira, with at most two-year site-pair sampling offset; same-day sampling NOT assumed
site_join.woody_site_sampling: One author Event per Terceira 50m×50m plot; reject replicated tree site rows claiming independent plots
site_join.beetle_site_sampling: Original 308 sub-method Events nested in 16 50m×50m plots; require each Terceira plot has at least eight original method event records, at least four samplingProtocol mode categories common across every site, and overall max/min events per plot <=1.5. Do not treat those Events as 308 independent plots.
site_join.field_enforcement: Input source must contain locationID, island, event date, latitude/longitude. If one field genuinely absent stop before plant/arthropod response.

report: Only aggregate original Event counts and method-class shared-set sizes, per-island plot counts, 10/10 exact joins, coordinate max absolute differences, date ranges, beetle sampling method counts by anonymous category and source-coreID crosswalk SHA256; no original site labels, coordinates, full dates or species emitted.
hard_stops: Fewer/more than ten exact author Terceira keys on either side
Any paired original location >0.0003 degrees apart
More than 1.5x beetle Event-method effort variation between matched plots
Fewer than four beetle common sampling modes
Unpaired taxon endpoints cannot repair source site IDs
next_possible_science: After v1.298 passes, prospectively freeze ORIGINAL tree native woody-assemblage and beetle endemic/community plot-by-species outcomes, sample effort and distance-based cross-taxon concordance metric before first Occurrence body access. Plot-label permutation must be on 10 unique sites, never 45 pairwise distances independently.
